summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of PasalBerapa? app (backend + frontend). All core functionality working correctly. Backend reference stub API validated (health, mask, analyze). Frontend wrapper validated (PDF upload, PII masking, risk analysis, chat, privacy vault, graceful error handling).
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/health returns 200 with status ok
Backend: POST /api/mask returns masked_text, mapping, entities (EMAIL, NIK, PHONE, PERSON detected)
Backend: POST /api/analyze with mode=risk returns reply, risk_score, risks array
Backend: POST /api/analyze with mode=summary returns summary reply
Backend: POST /api/analyze with mode=key_articles returns key articles reply
Backend: POST /api/analyze with mode=chat returns chat reply
Frontend: Landing page renders with PasalBerapa? branding, upload dropzone, trust bullets, status chip
Frontend: Settings modal opens, endpoints configured, connection tested, settings saved
Frontend: PDF upload via file input, text extraction successful
Frontend: Quick action 'Bedah Risiko' triggers risk analysis, displays 4 risk items with score 96
Frontend: Quick action 'Ringkas Isi' triggers summary analysis
Frontend: Quick action 'Jelaskan Pasal Terpenting' triggers key articles analysis
Frontend: Chat composer sends question and receives response
Frontend: Privacy Vault displays masked items (EMAIL, NIK, PHONE), reveal toggle with confirmation dialog works
Frontend: Document panel censored/uncensored toggle works
Frontend: Reset session button returns to landing page
Frontend: Graceful error handling - warning banner shown when endpoints not configured, no crashes
